mapper.sql: id, session_id, user_id, thread_id, terminal_session_id, agent_name, command, reason, status, created_at, decided_at, decided_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_approval (id, session_id, user_id, thread_id, terminal_session_id, agent_name, command, reason, status, created_at, decided_at, decided_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{threadId}, #{terminalSessionId}, #{agentName}, #{command}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{decidedAt}, #{decidedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_approval WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC
